name: Monzo consumer banking homepage by monzo.com
description: A long consumer bank homepage built almost entirely from rounded slabs and cards that alternate between white, warm grey, hot coral and deep navy, creating a strong colour rhythm as you scroll. The hero pairs warm lifestyle photography with a short bold headline, then the page moves through carousel-based feature rows, a bento grid of support tiles, a sign-up stepper, and finally unusually transparent survey-ranking tables drawn with coral bars. Pill buttons, 16–24px radii, phone mockups and tiny regulatory small print give it a friendly but credible financial tone.
